depmap.name: depmap
depmap.what_it_measures: Genome-wide CRISPR knockout gene-effect scores (Chronos) and RNAi dependency scores across a large panel of cancer cell lines, plus matched multi-omics (expression, mutation, copy number).
depmap.version_used: DepMap public release (see pipeline config for exact quarter)
depmap.caveats: Cell line panel is skewed toward well-characterised lines; dependency scores are model-derived, not direct measurements.
depmap.reference: Tsherniak et al., Cell 2017; Dempster et al., Nat Commun 2019

hpa.name: hpa
hpa.what_it_measures: Protein and RNA expression profiles across human tissues, cell lines, and subcellular locations, based on antibody-based immunohistochemistry and mass spectrometry.
hpa.version_used: See pipeline config for exact version
hpa.caveats: Antibody-based measurements can vary in specificity; not all cell lines have proteomics coverage.

geo.name: geo
geo.what_it_measures: Public repository of functional genomics data, including microarray and RNA-seq expression datasets submitted by independent labs.
geo.caveats: Highly heterogeneous across submissions; batch effects and inconsistent metadata are common.
geo.reference: Edgar et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2002

cellosaurus.name: cellosaurus
cellosaurus.what_it_measures: A knowledge resource on cell lines, providing standardised identifiers, synonyms, provenance, and cross-references to other cell line databases.
cellosaurus.version_used: See pipeline config for exact release
cellosaurus.caveats: Used for identity mapping, not molecular data; does not provide expression or dependency measurements.

ensembl.name: ensembl
ensembl.what_it_measures: Genome annotation database providing gene models, transcript structures, and stable gene identifiers (ENSG IDs).
ensembl.version_used: See pipeline config for exact release/assembly
ensembl.caveats: Annotation changes across releases can shift gene boundaries or symbols.
ensembl.reference: Cunningham et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2022

cosmic.name: cosmic
cosmic.full_name: Catalogue of Somatic Mutations in Cancer
cosmic.what_it_measures: Curated database of somatic mutations, cancer gene census annotations (e.g. driver gene / tumour suppressor status), and mutation signatures in cancer.
cosmic.version_used: See pipeline config for exact release
cosmic.caveats: Requires license for commercial use; driver gene labels reflect current evidence and may lag behind newer literature.
cosmic.reference: Tate et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2019

hgnc.name: hgnc
hgnc.what_it_measures: Authoritative source for human gene naming, providing approved gene symbols, full names, previous/retired symbols, and known aliases.
hgnc.version_used: Live REST API queries, no fixed version
hgnc.caveats: Symbol approvals can change over time; always cross-validate against Ensembl for ID consistency.
hgnc.reference: Seal et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2023
